# GEOMETRY

> Fixed, structured answers for date questions — birth cards, calendars, moon phases, seasons, retrogrades, and ~30 systems on 1900–2100. Connect over MCP.

## Canonical MCP URL

https://mcp.geometry.app/mcp

Use this URL only in install instructions. Do not teach `*.zuplo.app` hosts.

## Docs

- [Who we are](https://docs.geometry.app/introduction): What GEOMETRY is
- [Quickstart](https://docs.geometry.app/quickstart): Paste the connector URL — Claude Code, Desktop, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code
- [Install walkthrough](https://geometry.app/tutorial/): Animated installs for every client above on geometry.app
- [Where your key goes](https://docs.geometry.app/connect-and-keys): `?key=` URL form, rotate, cancel
- [Why deterministic](https://docs.geometry.app/why-deterministic): Same call → same JSON
- [What you get](https://docs.geometry.app/payload-shapes): The tools, field counts, payload conventions, and repeating shapes
- [get_birthdate](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-birthdate): Birth identity (Production; formerly get_card_for_birthdate)
- [get_compatibility](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-compatibility): Two birth dates (Production)
- [get_day](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-day): Day card + day ruler (Beta; formerly get_day_card)
- [get_name](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-name): Name → Cosmic Cards (Beta; formerly get_name_cosmic_cards)
- [When it covers](https://docs.geometry.app/coverage): Systems on the date range + calendar boundaries (two date families — sky events GMT; cultural years per tradition)
- [Astro wheels](https://docs.geometry.app/astro-wheels): Five sign systems + ecliptic degree spans — tropical · vedic_rasi · fagan_bradley · sidereal_iau · sidereal_true (disagreement across wheels is expected)
- [Field glossary](https://docs.geometry.app/field-glossary): `_no` fields — tradition vs catalog ids, `0`/`none` sentinels
- [HTTP API](https://docs.geometry.app/http-api): Secondary surface — same tools over HTTP; MCP first; branded `api.geometry.app` curl docs later
- [Support](https://docs.geometry.app/support): Self-serve for free / soft launch; GitHub Issues for paid plans only (product / connectivity bugs)
- [FAQ](https://docs.geometry.app/faq): Common questions

## Support

Builders: https://docs.geometry.app/support — docs / portal / walkthrough first. No public product email.
GitHub Issues: paid plans only (Starter+); soft launch and Free = self-serve. Scope = product / connectivity failures — not zodiac or calendar disagreements (/astro-wheels · /coverage#calendar-boundaries).
Leaked key: roll in Developer Portal — https://docs.geometry.app/connect-and-keys (never paste the key).

## Rules for agents

- All string fields lowercase except glyph fields (e.g. `unicard_symbol`, `alchemical_symbol`).
- NEVER retype rare Unicode from memory when saving tool JSON. Paste the tool result bytes unchanged. Alchemical Symbols (U+1F700–U+1F77F) and planetary glyphs corrupt easily into lookalike emoji (e.g. U+1F70A → U+1F30A water wave). That is an LLM serialization hazard — not a GEOMETRY defect. Verify glyphs with codepoints. Numbers, cards, and cipher sums in a mangled copy may still be correct; do not invent “emoji cleanup” for glyph fields from a chat file. See https://docs.geometry.app/faq#llm-unicode-glyphs and https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-name
- Missing scalars use sentinels — `0` numeric, `none` text, `""` symbol, `[]` list — not `null`. Known exception: `day_ruler.norse.deity` is `null` on Saturdays (laugardagr has no deity). `_no` fields are non-negative.
- `_no` fields are opaque ids for tracing/support — not a public contract. Key on names and slugs. Exceptions carrying real tradition meaning: `card_no`, `tarot_no`, `iching_no`, `atomic_no`, `chakra_no`, `house_no`, `pada_no`.
- Published full window: 1900-01-01 … 2100-12-31 (`temporal_context: "full"`). Nearby dates outside that window return `"extended"` (same calculations, honest label). Farther out returns `"birth_card_only"` / `"day_card_only"` with a soft error envelope.
- Sky anchors (moon / season / retrograde) are pre-computed offline with open-source **pyswisseph** (https://github.com/astrorigin/pyswisseph), then stored as lookups. No live ephemeris at request time. See /coverage.
- Dates come in TWO families and the JSON does not label them. (1) Sky events — `moon_phase.*_anchor_dt`, `season.*_anchor_dt`, `retrogrades_active.retro_start_dt`/`retro_end_dt`/`cazimi_dt` — are the Gregorian day containing the instant in **GMT**. A local-time source will differ by one day roughly `offset ÷ 24` of the time (~33% at UTC+8). (2) Cultural years — `lunar.year_no`, `calendar_years.*` — use each tradition's own civil anchor: Chinese/Vietnamese CST (UTC+8), Vedic samvatsara IST (UTC+5:30), Hebrew and Dreamspell timezone-neutral (arithmetic, cannot shift), Persian GMT day-of-equinox by deliberate choice (may differ one day from Iran's Tehran-local rule).
- Inputs are bare dates; no timezone conversion happens at request time. Do not tell users a one-day difference is a bug before checking which family the field belongs to. See /coverage#calendar-boundaries.
- GEOMETRY returns structured reference data; interpretation is the host app / model.
- Site: https://geometry.app · Company: https://goqo.com
- Builder support: self-serve docs at https://docs.geometry.app/support · Issues only for reproducible bugs on https://github.com/goqolabs/geometry-mcp
